title: Merge the Queues
statement:
There are `k` lines of people, each already sorted by ticket number in non-decreasing order. Merge all the lines into one line sorted in non-decreasing order. Let the merged line be `x_1 ... x_N`.

Print `(1*x_1 + 2*x_2 + ... + N*x_N) mod 1000000007`.

## Input
The first line contains `k`. Each of the next `k` lines starts with `m_i`, the size of that line, followed by its `m_i` numbers in non-decreasing order.

## Output
Print the value described above.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= 8000`
- `1 <= m_i`, and the sizes add up to at most `15000`
- `0 <= x <= 10^9`
